notes.title: "Tribe: Primitive Builder" Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hello, Players!

Together with [b]Polyslash[/b] we're excited to share some thrilling news today. [b]"Tribe: Primitive Builder,[/b]" our prehistoric city-building and survival game, is now officially available on Steam. 

It's been an exhilarating journey, and we can't wait to take you back in time to the age of primitive tribes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/27dc73bdd279116e1e3116f6beeb3cacabf8d1b6.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Launch Day - Unleash Your Inner Primitive Builder![/h1]

After months of hard work, sleepless nights, and countless playtesting sessions, [b]"Tribe: Primitive Builder"[/b] is ready to make its mark on Steam. The game is now live and available for purchase. Get ready to lead your tribe to prosperity in a stunning prehistoric world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/bf46bc5227b765e378b28d0748ad802dc682175d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Community Hub: Join the Tribe![/h1]

A great game deserves an equally great community, and we invite you to join ours on the Steam Community Hub for [b]"Tribe: Primitive Builder." [/b]
Share your strategies, discuss the best ways to survive, and connect with fellow prehistoric architects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/2b65e089c9f50fab89b601ea8da3792be51ea69a.jpg[/img]


[h1]Tribe+Prison bundle![/h1]

[b]"Tribe: Primitive Builder" [/b]is now available on Steam, and we can't wait for you to embark on your adventure. Get your copy today and let's build, survive, and thrive together!
Also a Prison Simulator+Tribe:Primitive Builder bundle will be available!
Get this to achieve a -10% discount!

[h1]Click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33313/Prison_Builder/]HERE[/url] to get a bundle! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/69ec499bee4a7ac866ee1d45812e0da6625b0215.jpg[/img]

[h1]A Big Thank You[/h1]

It's a joint cooperation of many developers, here in Baked Games and other companies :D 
We're immensely proud of what we've achieved together.

Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Steam Next Festival - New Demos for Neuroshima Hex and Hammer of Pain!
notes.notes:
[h1]Special announcement![/h1]

Hello travelers!

We hope you're all set to dive into the gaming extravaganza that is [b]Steam Next Festival[/b]!
We've got some thrilling news to share with you that will add more fun to your festival experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/88d36564c93b6d71378355fc0e91e9ae0e9c210a.png[/img]

[h3]Introducing brand-new demos for two of our epic titles, [i][b]Neuroshima Hex[/b][/i] and[i][b] Hammer of Pain![/b][/i][/h3]

We're cranking up the fun factor to the limit, and we can't wait for you to jump in and play. 
These demos will be available at the start of [b]Steam Next Festival[/b] on [b]9th October 2023![/b]

[h1][b]Neuroshima Hex Demo:[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/9659a0cce87aa1972a02116cdd242477c1999fec.gif[/img]

Calling all strategic masterminds! Get ready to flex your tactical muscles with our revamped [i]Neuroshima Hex[/i] demo. 
It's the perfect way to dip your toes into the world of Mad Max-inspired battles, where every move counts. 
The demo even supports [b]online multiplayer[/b], so you can test your skills against players from around the world!
[h3]
Click here to play the Neuroshima Hex demo right now![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2324150?utm_source=CCdv       

[b][h1]Hammer of Pain Demo:[/h1][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/bc2e46b72456d562a897c529c3df0739a734e224.gif[/img]

For those who crave adrenaline-pumping, heart-thumping action, our [i]Hammer of Pain[/i] demo is your ticket to an epic journey of chaos and conquest. Dive headfirst into this brutal world and show 'em who's boss. Plus, enjoy the beautiful retro-inspired [b]pixel art graphics[/b]!

[h3]Click here to play the Hammer of Pain demo right now![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438440/Hammer_of_Pain/?utm_source=CCdv 

[h3]Community and Contest:[/h3]

We want to hear feedback from you! Share your demo experiences, epic victories, and hilarious defeats with the gaming community on Steam or our [b]Discord[/b] server. 

Speaking of Discord, during the festival, we'll be hosting a special [b]CONTEST[/b] on our official server!

What are the rules? You play our demos and aim to be the very best! You can then win great prizes! More info on the Discord server.

[h1]Join our Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/xrDfW5RMCa]here[/url]![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/dcfd6c6d8c00027ba503f254277de421f6aec639.png[/img]

Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Try out demo of our new game - Plow the Snow !
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Hello dear Players![/h1][/b]

We got special announcement for you!
We wanna invite you - [b]Players [/b]to check out a demo for a new game that we are developing!
This game is called [i]Plow the Snow![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c1d67ad0b06f2c99e712213c149b3100db3b3f16.png[/img]

What is it game about? It is a [b]simulator[/b] and [b]casual relaxing[/b] game with a bit cartoony stylized graphic centered around getting rid of the snow in various places !
Help your clients and neighbors get through this winter season. 
You can use multiple machines and brave any obstacle in your path to make the sidewalks and streets free from the snowflake menace!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0231325a478a41b61da6d57cded1bef56bbd869f.gif[/img]

[h3]What can you expect in demo version? 
[/h3]

[h3]-Two different levels + garage !

-Great stylized graphic and atmosphere

-Relaxing gameplay and music.

-Fixing stuff in your vehicle in garage! 

-A lot of fun (and a lot of snow to plow) ![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7c07d517acd343d39317b60bf8e6152be0b7a9c1.gif[/img]

Full version will have a lot of levels and also a multiplayer!

Put your gloves on, warm jackets and be ready to Plow the Snow!
Don’t wait, help Snow Angeles to clean up the snow in city !
[h2]Download demo on Steam and don’t forget to wishlist the full game 😉[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967530/Plow_the_Snow/

Players feedback was always close in our hearts and we want to fulfill every player's desire !
Tell us in comments, on Steam Community or on our Discord server what was your's feelings about game ;)

Enjoy and have fun!

Baked Games Team
